import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Filter and prepare the data for visualization
age_distribution = data['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts().reset_index()
age_distribution.columns = ['Age Group', 'Number of Dogs']

# Create a bar plot for age distribution of dogs
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.barplot(data=age_distribution, x='Age Group', y='Number of Dogs', palette='viridis')
plt.title('Age Distribution of Registered Dogs in Zurich', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=14)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.grid(axis='y')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Filter and prepare the data for visualization
age_distribution = data['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts().reset_index()
age_distribution.columns = ['Age Group', 'Number of Dogs']

# Create a bar plot for age distribution of dogs
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.barplot(data=age_distribution, x='Age Group', y='Number of Dogs', palette='viridis')
plt.title('Age Distribution of Registered Dogs in Zurich', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=14)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.grid(axis='y')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
